products.name: Pulse One
products.description: A considered addition to your wind-down ritual. A sculpted handle, interchangeable contact head, and a compact form that fits into everyday life.
products.detail: This original product explores a simple, tactile percussion device. The standard kit includes the illustrated device and round attachment; the travel kit adds a product carrying sleeve.

products.name: Form Roller
products.description: A little space to stretch out. A textured foam-roller product designed around a straightforward, repeatable mobility ritual.
products.detail: A considered surface and open core create a simple piece of everyday movement equipment. Choose the size that suits your space.

products.description: Small tools. Room to move. A coordinated set of three resistance-loop products for a more intentional movement corner.

products.detail: An uncomplicated pair designed to sit comfortably in a movement kit. Any therapeutic benefit would need independent evidence.
